title: Application Scientist
description: About CuspAI CuspAI is the frontier AI company on a mission to solve the breakthrough materials needed to power human progress. While nature took billions of years to perfect molecules, we are harnessing AI to unlock trillion-dollar materials breakthroughs in months, not millennia. Our founding team is the most cited in the world, comprised of world-class researchers in AI, chemistry and engineering. We are working on some of the hardest and most important challenges including energy, clean water, the future of compute, and carbon capture, and this is just the start of what our 'search engine' for next-generation materials will unlock. We invite you to be part of a diverse, innovative team at the intersection of AI and materials science, working to create impactful partnerships that drive innovation, scalability, and industry collaboration. This work matters. Your work matters. We’re on the cusp of the on-demand materials era. Join us. The Role We hire across a spectrum of backgrounds. Some Application Scientists are computational (atomistic and molecular simulation, machine-learned force fields), some are experimental (synthesis, processing, characterisation, lab automation), and some are data-driven (materials and cheminformatics, optimisation). What they share is the ability to turn a partner’s problem into a plan, deliver it, and translate fluently between experimental, computational, and machine learning teams. We operate a matrix structure. You will have a home team, but may contribute to projects in another pillar as demand and your expertise evolve. Your Impact You will own the scientific delivery of partner projects, from scoping to results. Working with our technical programme managers, ML researchers, platform engineers, and lab integration team, you will make sure our platform answers the questions that matter to partners, and that what is learned on each project feeds back into tools and workflows used across the company. Alongside delivery, you will help build the cross-cutting capabilities that future projects depend on, such as validated workflows, harmonised data pipelines and agentic design campaigns. Application Areas We are particularly interested in candidates with expertise in one or more of the areas below. You do not need to cover a whole pillar. Electronics : Semiconductor processing, device-level modelling and electronics, photonic and thermal materials Energy : Catalysis, batteries, photovoltaics and multiscale kinetics. Environment : Porous and soft materials, interfaces, and separations Cross-cutting : Materials informatics, automated experimentation and optimisation. What You Will Do Project leadership and delivery Lead partner projects from scoping to delivery, as a key point of contact alongside the technical program managers. Write technical scopes that define objectives, deliverables, success criteria, and timelines. Prepare regular technical reports and presentations for partners and internal teams. Science and campaigns Apply and extend our platform to partner problems, using simulation, machine learning, data-driven optimisation, or experiments as the project requires. Design and steer discovery campaigns, including agentic and closed-loop campaigns with partner labs. Assess when models, simulations, and data can be trusted, and contribute to validating them against experiments. Bridging experimental and computational teams Translate platform recommendations into clear, executable experimental plans, and translate lab realities back into requirements for internal teams. Make sure data from partners and our own workflows are clean, structured, and consistent. Work closely with partner labs, including on-site visits at key stages of a project. Capability and product development Build and automate workflows that run reliably at scale within our platform. Relay partner feedback to TPMs, ML researchers, and platform engineers to improve tools and workflows. Stay informed about advances in your field and contribute to the scientific direction of your team. Must Have Skills and Qualifications A PhD in chemistry, materials science, physics, chemical engineering, or a related field, or equivalent industry experience. Deep, hands-on expertise in at least one of: atomistic simulation (including machine-learned force fields); experimental materials or chemistry, ideally with automation or high-throughput methods; materials or cheminformatics with machine learning and optimisation. A track record in one or more of the application areas above. Python skills for data handling, analysis, automation or modelling, and familiarity with version control (Git). Exceptional ability to communicate with both experimental and computational scientists, and to translate between them. A personal passion for CuspAI's mission and the potential of AI to unlock breakthroughs in materials science. Bonus Points (But Not Critical) Industry experience, particularly in the semiconductor, electronics, energy, or chemical sectors. Experience leading projects or collaborations with external partners, including writing technical scopes or proposals. Experience with multiscale modelling, from atomistic to mesoscale, continuum or device level. Practical synthesis or processing experience, with an understanding of what makes a route feasible and reproducible. Professional software engineering practice, such as code review, testing and deployment. Prior experience in a start-up or fast-growth technology company. Additional Considerations These roles can be based in our London, Cambridge, Amsterdam, or Berlin offices, with the expectation of being in the office at least three days per week. There may be regular travel to partner sites and other CuspAI offices for collaboration and project work. What We Offer A competitive salary: We value and reward impact and growth Equity in CuspAI: You have a stake in the success of the company Time off to stay fresh: 28 days holiday (DE, NL, UK) or 21 days holiday (JP, SG, US), in addition to local public holidays ‘Gold Standard’ parental leave: 26 weeks (primary caregiver) and 12 weeks (secondary caregiver) at full pay - we look after you and your family while we work on the most important materials discovery problems together Professional development budget: We invest in your career development so you can stay up to date with the latest industry knowledge or add to your skills to increase impact and growth Solve meaningful problems: See how your work has a direct impact on advancing materials science and solving sustainability and climate-related problems through the creation and application of bleeding-edge SOTA technology and revolutionary techniques True interdisciplinary teamwork: Be part of a deeply collaborative environment bridging AI research, computational chemistry, and experimental science - work with world-class researchers and engineers who enjoy sharing knowledge and supporting each other Join us in shaping the future of materials with AI. Together, we can create groundbreaking solutions for a more sustainable world. CuspAI is an equal opportunities employer committed to building a diverse and inclusive workplace . title: Senior Manager, HR Process Excellence
description: <div class="content-intro"><p><strong>Who We Are </strong></p> <p>Verve has created a more efficient and privacy-focused way to buy and monetize advertising. Verve is an ecosystem of demand and supply technologies fusing data, media, and technology together to deliver results and growth to both advertisers and publishers–no matter the screen or location, no matter who, what, or where a customer is. With offices across the globe and with an eye on servicing forward-thinking advertising customers, Verve’s solutions are trusted by more than 90 of the United States’ top 100 advertisers, 4,000 publishers globally, and the world’s top demand-side platforms. Learn more at <a href="https://verve.com/">verve.com</a>.<strong><br></strong></p></div><p><strong>What we're looking for:</strong></p> <p>We are seeking a commercially minded <strong>Senior Manager, HR Process Excellence</strong> to drive the design, optimisation and continuous improvement of HR processes across Verve Group. </p> <p>As the subject matter expert (SME) for HR process excellence, you will partner with HR leadership and leaders across the organisation. You will be identifying opportunities to improve the effectiveness of HR processes across the employee lifecycle. Key principles are simplicity and scalability as we embark on the next exciting stage of growth.</p> <p data-pm-slice="1 1 []"><em>This is a temp-to-perm role offering a hybrid working arrangement, with three days per week in our London office in Covent Garden.</em></p> <p><strong>What you’ll be doing:</strong></p> <p><strong>HR Process Excellence & Continuous Improvement</strong></p> <ul> <li>Act as the organisation's subject matter expert for HR process excellence, providing specialist guidance and thought leadership across a broad range of HR initiatives.</li> <li>Lead the end-to-end assessment, design, redesign and optimisation of HR processes across the employee lifecycle.</li> <li>Identify opportunities to eliminate inefficiencies, reduce complexity, remove duplication and improve process effectiveness, quality and user experience.</li> <li>Challenge legacy processes and existing ways of working, driving a culture of simplification and scalability.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Delivery of HR Improvement Initiatives</strong></p> <ul> <li>Lead and support multiple process improvement initiatives across HR, working across a portfolio of priorities that may include recruitment, onboarding, employee lifecycle management, HR operations, performance management, talent, reward and employee offboarding.</li> <li>Develop business cases, quantify benefits and define measurable success criteria for proposed improvements.</li> <li>Oversee implementation of agreed process changes, ensuring solutions are practical, scalable and simple!  </li> </ul> <p><strong>Stakeholder Engagement & Business Partnering</strong></p> <ul> <li>Build strong relationships across the business. </li> <li>Act as a trusted adviser to senior stakeholders, providing expert recommendations on process design and improvement opportunities.</li> <li>Balance commercial impact with legal risk and bring together internal stakeholders to align on a path forward. </li> </ul> <p><strong>HR Technology, Data & Automation</strong></p> <ul> <li>Partner with HR Ops and Intelligence teams to identify opportunities for automation, workflow optimisation, self-service and improved use of HR systems.</li> <li>Ensure process improvements are designed with technology enablement and automation at their core. </li> <li>Promote data-driven decision-making and the use of digital solutions to improve HR service across the entire employee experience.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Change Management & Capability Building</strong></p> <ul> <li>Support the adoption of redesigned processes through effective stakeholder engagement, communications, training and change management.</li> <li>Equip HR teams and process owners with the tools, frameworks and knowledge required to sustain improvements independently.</li> <li>Share best practices, lessons learned and reusable process improvement approaches across HR.</li> <li>Champion a continuous improvement mindset, encouraging teams to challenge existing practices and take ownership of operational effectiveness.</li> </ul> <p><strong>What you'll need:</strong></p> <p><strong>Essential Experience</strong></p> <ul> <li>Significant experience in HR process improvement, change management/transformation. Ideally a consultancy background, either internal or external. </li> <li>Demonstrable experience leading end-to-end process improvement initiatives within a global, rapidly growing organisation. </li> <li>Strong understanding of HR processes across multiple areas of the employee lifecycle. </li> <li>Experience managing multiple initiatives simultaneously, from initial assessment and solution design through to implementation and benefits realisation.</li> <li>Strong stakeholder management and influencing skills, with the credibility to engage and challenge senior leaders.</li> <li>Demonstrable ability to lead change, influence adoption and embed sustainable improvements across teams.</li> <li>Strong knowledge of process excellence methodologies this could include but not limited to Lean, Six Sigma, value stream mapping, root cause analysis and continuous improvement.</li> <li>Strong analytical skills, including the ability to interpret operational data, establish baselines and measure improvement outcomes.</li> <li>Understanding of HR technology, workflow automation, digital self-service and the role of technology in enabling process transformation.</li> <li>Exceptional communication, facilitation and presentation skills, with the ability to influence stakeholders at all levels.</li> </ul> <p><strong>What We Offer</strong></p> <p>Just a few of the benefits waiting for you at Verve: </p> <ul> <li>Stay healthy with our<strong> Bupa HealthCare Plan</strong> with easy access to medical care</li> <li>Support your long-term financial security with our <strong>Aviva Corporate Pension Scheme</strong>, with Verve contributing 3% of your qualifying earnings</li> <li>Pick what matters most to you in our <strong>Personalized Benefits Platform, </strong>with a budget of<strong>  </strong>£50/month</li> <li>Recharge with <strong>25 paid vacation days + 3 Wellness days </strong>throughout the year, in addition to the public holidays</li> </ul> <p><strong>Boost your professional knowledge with our annual training budget & internal webinars</strong>… and even more reasons to join us!</p><div class="content-conclusion"><p><span style="font-size: 8pt;">Verve provides equal employment opportunities to all employees and applicants for employment and prohibits discrimination and harassment of any type without regard to race, color, religion, age, sex, national origin, disability status, genetics, protected veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state or local laws. <br><br>If you are a California resident subject to the California Consumer Privacy Act, <a href="https://verve.com/california-applicant-privacy-notice/" target="_blank">click here</a> to understand how Verve processes your personal information and how you can exercise your rights.<br></span><span style="font-size: 8pt;">If you are located in the EU or UK visit our </span><a style="font-size: 8pt;" href="https://verve.com/applicant-privacy-policy/" target="_blank">privacy policy</a><span style="font-size: 8pt;"> to understand how Verve processes your personal information and how you can exercise your rights.</span></p></div> Find more English Speaking Jobs in United Kingdom on Arbeitnow

title: Agentic AI Principal
description: <div class="description content"> <p>We are looking for an <strong>Agentic AI Principal</strong> to act as a senior technical authority and trusted client advisor for complex agentic AI transformation in the UK and Ireland.</p> <p>Operating at Principal level, you will shape enterprise AI strategy, define agentic architecture blueprints, lead high-value C-suite engagements and guide complex programmes from opportunity through delivery. You will bring deep hands-on credibility in multi-agent systems, governance and safeguards, while setting reusable patterns and raising capability across teams.</p> <p>The role has particular focus on sovereign, compliant and production-grade agentic AI for regulated UK enterprise environments, including financial services and telecommunications.</p> </div> <h2 id="job-responsibilities">Job responsibilities</h2> <div class="job-responsibilities content"> <ul> <li><strong>Agentic AI Advisory & Strategy: </strong>Shape and solution complex UKI pursuits, working with account, commercial and delivery leaders to translate client needs into differentiated propositions, credible architectures and executable delivery approaches that support regional pipeline conversion.</li> <li><strong>Design & Build Engineering:</strong> Set the architecture direction for complex, production-grade agentic AI systems, including multi-agent workflows, orchestration, tool use, memory, context strategy, retrieval, evaluation, observability and enterprise integration.</li> <li><strong>Governance & Safeguards: </strong>Establish reusable patterns for observability, auditability, traceability and control of agentic systems, enabling teams to demonstrate safe and reliable behaviour in production.</li> <li><strong>Principal-level leadership: </strong>Set reusable architecture patterns, engineering standards and governance practices across multiple teams and engagements, influencing the evolution of Thoughtworks’ agentic AI capability beyond an individual programme.</li> <li>Design solutions appropriate for regulated UK environments, including financial services and telecommunications, with strong consideration of data sovereignty, privacy, security, responsible AI and applicable regulatory requirements.</li> <li>Provide technical and delivery leadership for complex programmes, maintaining sufficient hands-on involvement to validate architecture, unblock teams, manage technical risk and ensure successful execution.</li> <li>Set technical direction across multiple teams and initiatives, defining reusable patterns, frameworks and engineering standards for agentic AI delivery.</li> <li>Guide teams in balancing rapid experimentation with robust production engineering, including evaluation-driven development, testing, CI/CD, reliability, cost and performance optimisation.</li> <li>Partner with product, data, software engineering, enterprise architecture, governance and change specialists to design end-to-end solutions that deliver measurable business outcomes.</li> <li>Anticipate technical, organisational and governance challenges in enterprise AI adoption and define practical approaches to address them.</li> <li>Mentor senior engineers and technical leads, uplift broader engineering capability, and build confidence in agentic AI practices across specialists and generalists.</li> <li>Evaluate emerging agentic AI technologies and frameworks and guide their responsible adoption based on client context, engineering quality and business value.</li> <li>Represent Thoughtworks' agentic AI expertise in strategic client conversations, industry forums, partnerships and thought leadership where appropriate.</li> </ul> </div> <h2 id="job-qualifications">Job qualifications</h2> <div class="job-qualifications content"> <h3 id="technical-skills">Technical Skills</h3> <div class="qualifications inner-content"> <ul> <li>Deep expertise in modern software engineering and Python, with a strong track record of setting standards for testing, CI/CD, observability, maintainability and production reliability.</li> <li>Recognised experience architecting and delivering complex GenAI and agentic AI systems at enterprise scale, from early discovery through production deployment.</li> <li>Deep knowledge of agentic architectures and frameworks such as LangGraph, AutoGen, CrewAI, LlamaIndex or equivalent, including tool use, orchestration, memory and multi-t coordination patterns.</li> <li>Strong expertise in Retrieval-Augmented Generation, advanced information retrieval, vector databases and enterprise knowledge integration.</li> <li>Experience designing evaluation strategies for GenAI and agentic systems, including quality, safety, reliability, latency and cost measures.</li> <li>Strong understanding of AI governance and safeguards, including guardrails, red-teaming, observability, responsible AI and secure deployment practices.</li> <li>Significant experience deploying AI systems on major cloud platforms using containers, orchestration and production-grade infrastructure patterns.</li> <li>Experience with model adaptation and optimisation techniques, including prompt/context engineering, fine-tuning where appropriate, and application-level performance optimisation.</li> <li>Ability to make sound architecture trade-offs across model capability, reliability, security, compliance, performance and cost.</li> </ul> </div> <h3 id="professional-skills">Professional Skills</h3> <div class="skills inner-content"> <ul> <li>Proven ability to lead C-suite and senior client engagements, rapidly establish credibility and advise on both business and technical choices.</li> <li>Strong consulting and commercial judgement, including experience shaping high-value opportunities, building investment cases and contributing directly to complex pipeline conversion.</li> <li>Ability to lead AI maturity assessments, identify and prioritise processes for agentization, and connect architecture choices to measurable business value and ROI.</li> <li>Executive presence and communication skills, with the ability to make complex agentic AI concepts, risks and trade-offs clear to technical and non-technical audiences.</li> <li>Proven leadership of complex delivery across multidisciplinary teams, with the ability to move fluidly between strategy, architecture, governance and hands-on technical leadership.</li> <li>Ability to influence across organisations without relying on formal authority, align diverse stakeholders and navigate ambiguity in high-value or high-risk programmes.</li> <li>Proven ability to mentor senior engineers and technical leaders and to raise standards and capability across a wider engineering community.</li> </ul> </div> </div> <h2 id="important-things">Other things to know</h2> <div class="important-things content"> <h3>Learning & Development</h3> <div class="inner-content"> <p>There is no one-size-fits-all career path at Thoughtworks: however you want to develop your career is entirely up to you. But we also balance autonomy with the strength of our cultivation culture. This means your career is supported by interactive tools, numerous development programs and teammates who want to help you grow. We see value in helping each other be our best and that extends to empowering our employees in their career journeys.</p> </div> </div> <h2 id="responsible-ai-use">Responsible Use of AI in Recruitment</h2> <div class="responsible-ai-use content"> <p>At Thoughtworks, we use AI tools to support our recruitment team with administrative tasks such as drafting communications, scheduling interviews and writing job descriptions.<br><br>Crucially, our AI tools do not screen, assess, rank or make hiring decisions. Every application is reviewed by our team and all selection decisions are made exclusively by our interviewers and hiring managers.<br><br>We are committed to fairness and responsible AI. We actively manage our AI systems by testing, monitoring for biased outcomes and implementing mitigation measures. We hold our third-party vendors to these same high standards through a rigorous governance process. For additional information, please see our full <a href="https://www.thoughtworks.com/careers/ai-policy-for-recruitment" target="_blank">Thoughtworks AI Policy for Recruitment</a>.</p> </div> <h2 id="about">About Thoughtworks</h2> <div class="about content"> <p>Thoughtworks is a dynamic and inclusive community of bright and supportive colleagues who are revolutionizing tech. As a leading technology consultancy, we’re pushing boundaries through our purposeful and impactful work. performance and cost.</li> </ul> </div> <h3 id="professional-skills">Professional Skills</h3> <div class="skills inner-content"> <ul> <li>Proven ability to lead C-suite and senior client engagements, title: Senior Technical Program Manager, International Security & Privacy Compliance
description: <div class="content-intro"><div> <div> <div class="gmail_quote"> <div> <div><span id="m_-113912706363268805m_-2746164444908759431gmail-docs-internal-guid-131e4fb0-7fff-b4e9-ff50-e8cf32449b1b">CoreWeave is The Essential Cloud for AI™. Built for pioneers by pioneers, CoreWeave delivers a platform of technology, tools, and teams that enables innovators to build and scale AI with confidence. Trusted by leading AI labs, startups, and global enterprises, CoreWeave combines superior infrastructure performance with deep technical expertise to accelerate breakthroughs and turn compute into capability. Founded in 2017, CoreWeave became a publicly traded company (Nasdaq: CRWV) in March 2025. Learn more at <a href="https://www.coreweave.com">www.coreweave.com</a>.</span></div> <div> </div> <div>We're proud to be a Living Wage accredited Employer.</div> </div> </div> </div> </div> <p> </p></div><p>CoreWeave is The Essential Cloud for AI™. Built for pioneers by pioneers, CoreWeave delivers a platform of technology, tools, and teams that enables innovators to build and scale AI with confidence. Trusted by leading AI labs, startups, and global enterprises, CoreWeave combines superior infrastructure performance with deep technical expertise to accelerate breakthroughs and turn compute into capability. Founded in 2017, CoreWeave became a publicly traded company (Nasdaq: CRWV) in March 2025. Learn more at <a href="http://www.coreweave.com/">www.coreweave.com</a>.</p> <h2><strong>About the Role</strong></h2> <p>CoreWeave is taking its AI cloud and data center services to new countries. Each new market brings its own data protection, cybersecurity, and data residency requirements, and we have to meet them before we launch.</p> <p>As the Technical Program Manager for International Security & Privacy Compliance, you will own the program that gets CoreWeave compliant in each new market. You will turn local legal and regulatory requirements into controls, timelines, and owners. Then you will lead Legal, Privacy, Security, Data Center Operations, Product, and Go-to-Market through to a compliant launch. The problem is defined; the solution is not. You will build the playbook as you go and make it repeatable for each market that follows.</p> <p>The role is based in London so you can work during business hours with US teams and with teams in the Middle East and Asia-Pacific.</p> <h2><strong>What You'll Do</strong></h2> <ul> <li>Own the end-to-end compliance program for new-country launches, from early regulatory assessment through go-live and ongoing upkeep.</li> <li>Work with Legal and Privacy counsel to turn local laws into concrete technical and operational requirements. These cover data protection and privacy, cybersecurity, data localization and residency, cross-border data transfer, incident reporting, and registration or licensing. Legal owns the interpretation; you own turning it into delivery.</li> <li>Map country requirements to CoreWeave's existing control framework (SOC 2, ISO/IEC 27001, and related certifications). Find gaps and drive the work to close them with control owners in Security, Engineering, and Data Center Operations.</li> <li>Build and maintain source-of-truth program plans, a requirements register, and a dependency map for each market. Use them to drive high-quality execution against timelines leadership can rely on.</li> <li>Build country-specific incident and breach notification obligations into CoreWeave's incident response process before go-live.</li> <li>Find risks and blockers early, such as data residency limits on architecture, local vendor or partner obligations, and regulator timelines. Drive them to resolution across teams, or escalate them with clear options and tradeoffs.</li> <li>Coordinate privacy reviews and data protection impact assessments for in-country services, working with Privacy and Product.</li> <li>Bring compliance requirements into product and data center launch plans early, so customer-facing commitments, contracts, and Trust Center content reflect what we can actually deliver.</li> <li>Report program status, risk, and decisions needed to Security, Legal, and business leadership.</li> <li>Make the work repeatable. Turn each market's lessons into a scalable country-entry playbook, templates, and workflows in Jira and our GRC tooling.</li> </ul> <h2><strong>Who You Are</strong></h2> <ul> <li>[5+] years of relevant experience in international security and privacy compliance program management, GRC, or related technical program management, preferably at a cloud, data center, or infrastructure provider.</li> <li>A track record of managing end-to-end, large-scale, cross-functional programs with significant organizational impact under little or no supervision. You are comfortable with work that has a defined problem but no defined solution.</li> <li>Strong execution skills. You get things done to high quality on timelines people can trust.</li> <li>You identify risks and blockers early and drive them to resolution.</li> <li>A solid grounding in industry best practices and frameworks such as ISO/IEC 27001, ISO/IEC 27701, SOC 2, NIST CSF, and GDPR-style data protection regimes. You can make well-reasoned decisions and tradeoffs that fit CoreWeave's context.</li> <li>You quickly learn and keep up with the requirements of unfamiliar jurisdictions, well enough to take an active part in decisions with Legal, Security, and Engineering.</li> <li>You use feedback to shape priorities, and you make sure compliance solutions don't degrade the customer experience.</li> <li>You influence cross-functional decisions with a structured approach, data, and technical insight, to achieve the intended outcome. You also contribute to the wider CoreWeave community, for example by mentoring others.</li> <li>You win buy-in from critical stakeholders on your recommendations, define clear communication strategies tailored to the audience, from engineers to executives, and seek out feedback to improve how you work.</li> </ul> <h3><strong>Preferred</strong></h3> <ul> <li>Experience running compliance programs across several countries, especially in Asia-Pacific or the Middle East.</li> <li>Experience with data residency, sovereign cloud, or in-country hosting requirements for cloud or data center services.</li> <li>Certifications such as CIPP/E, CIPM, CISSP, CISM, CISA, or PMP.</li> <li>Experience with GRC platforms and with Jira-based program tracking.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Wondering if you're a good fit? We believe in investing in our people and value candidates who bring unique backgrounds, even if you don't check every box. Here are a few qualities we've found make someone successful on our team. If some of this describes you, we'd love to talk.</strong></p> <ul> <li>You're comfortable balancing compliance rigor with practical, scalable solutions.</li> <li>You take ownership, bring structure to ambiguity, and follow issues through to resolution.</li> <li>You communicate clearly with technical and non-technical stakeholders and build strong cross-functional partnerships.</li> <li>You're energized by building processes and systems that improve how teams work.</li> </ul><div class="content-conclusion"><p><em>To fulfill our obligation to protect client data, successful applicants offered employment with CoreWeave will be required to complete a basic criminal record check, conducted in compliance with GDPR. Employment offers are conditional upon receiving satisfactory check results.</em></p> <p><strong>What We Offer</strong></p> <p>In addition to a competitive salary, we offer a variety of benefits to support your needs, including:</p> <ul> <li>Family-level Medical Insurance</li> <li>Family-level Dental Insurance </li> <li>Generous Pension Contribution </li> <li>Life Assurance at 4x Salary </li> <li>Critical Illness Cover </li> <li>Employee Assistance Programme </li> <li>Tuition Reimbursement</li> <li>Work culture focused on innovative disruption</li> </ul> <p><em>Benefits may vary by location. </em></p> <p><strong>Equal Opportunity </strong></p> <p><em>CoreWeave is an equal opportunity employer, committed to fostering an inclusive and supportive workplace. All qualified applicants and candidates will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, disability, age, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, veteran status, or genetic information.</em></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;"><strong>Recruitment Agencies</strong></span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;"><em><em data-stringify-type="italic">CoreWeave does not accept speculative CVs. Any unsolicited CVs received will be treated as the property of CoreWeave and your Terms & Conditions associated with the use of CVs will be considered null and void.</em></em></span></p> <p><em><span style="font-weight: 400;"><em data-stringify-type="italic">Any unsolicited CVs sent by your company to us – that is to say, in any situation where we have not directly engaged your company in writing to supply candidates for a specific vacancy – will be considered by us to be a “free gift”, leaving us liable for no fees whatsoever should we choose to contact the candidate directly and engage the candidate’s services, and will in no way establish any prior claim by your company to representation of that candidate should the candidate’s details also be submitted by any other party.</em></span></em></p> <p><strong>Export Control Compliance</strong></p> <p>This position requires access to export controlled information.  To conform to U.S. Government export regulations applicable to that information, applicant must either be (A) a U.S. person, defined as a (i) U.S. citizen or national, (ii) U.S. lawful permanent resident (green card holder), (iii) refugee under 8 U.S.C. § 1157, or (iv) asylee under 8 U.S.C. § 1158, (B) eligible to access the export controlled information without a required export authorization, or (C) eligible and reasonably likely to obtain the required export authorization from the applicable U.S. government agency.  CoreWeave may, for legitimate business reasons, decline to pursue any export licensing process.</p> <p> </p> <p><strong><em>Updated privacy notice - UK and EU Job Applications </em></strong></p> <p><em>When you apply to a job on this site, the personal data contained in your application will be collected by CoreWeave UK Ltd. title: Release Manager - AI Models
description: Before the detail, here's the challenge you'd help us solve. We build the embodied intelligence that moves real vehicles safely, and the ecosystem a billion machines will run on in the future. Very few people in AI can say this. Every role here, whatever the team, plugs into that. Here’s what this particular role covers. 🛠️ About our Engineering Teams Our engineering teams bring together ML engineering, evaluation and data science, software platform, testing, and product to turn breakthrough autonomous-driving technology into reliable products. Model releases connect these disciplines, taking AI models from early hypotheses through training, evaluation, and on-road testing to deployment across our vehicle fleet. As our Release Manager — AI Models, you’ll help ensure that a core part of our technology — the AI model — is released reliably, on time, and to the standard required for production. You’ll bring structure and disciplined release practices to the fast-paced, non-deterministic world of ML, building the processes and systems that support clarity, stability, and business goals. 🧠 Your day-to-day Own the model release cycle, maintaining a steady and predictable cadence while adapting to changing business priorities. Coordinate across ML engineering, evaluation and data science, software platform, testing, and product to keep releases moving and resolve dependencies. Run the gates that promote models from hypothesis → training → evaluation → validation → deployment, making clear what is ready to ship and what needs more work. Drive investigations into regressions and integration issues, coordinate rollback or roll-forward decisions, and follow through on technical debt and corrective actions. Be the central point of contact for model-release status, risks, and timelines, giving engineers and leadership the right level of detail. title: Product Manager, Homepage
description: Our Global Structure Deliveroo is now part of DoorDash, bringing together teams with even greater reach, scale, and ambition. Join us in shaping the experience that millions of customers land on every time they open DoorDash, Wolt, or Deliveroo. As part of our Core Consumer organisation, our Homepage team owns one of the single biggest levers we have on what customers find and one of the hardest surfaces in the app to get right. Working at the intersection of ranking, personalisation, and AI/ML, you'll help decide what each customer sees and why, across three brands and dozens of markets. You'll be building on a global stack, and your roadmap will be a mix: global platform problems that apply worldwide, global capabilities we're accelerating into EMEA, and EMEA-specific problems worth solving properly rather than working around. We're looking for a Senior Product Manager to join our Homepage team. In this role, you'll shape how customers discover restaurants, grocery and retail venues, dishes and products — and help define what discovery looks like as AI-driven and agentic experiences change the way people decide what to order. What You'll Be Doing You'll be joining a team working on one of the most-used surfaces in the app. Here's what your day-to-day might look like: Building new end-to-end features and user experiences on Homepage that shape how customers discover restaurants, grocery and retail venues, dishes, and products. Working on ranking, personalisation, and AI/ML problems in the Homepage domain, including how we decide what each customer sees and why. Exploring where AI-driven and agentic experiences change the way customers discover what to order. Making discovery work across three brands and many markets, without flattening into one-size-fits-all. What You'll Need to Thrive Our ideal candidate will bring strong product judgment and curiosity to grow into the rest: Proven experience as a Product Manager on consumer-facing products - discovery, homepage, feed, or ranking-driven experiences are especially relevant. You are a product manager more than a feature owner. Someone who finds the customer problems that matter most and makes the case for solving them. You work backwards from the customer problem, and weigh it against what the business needs most right now. You're comfortable holding several business objectives at once and making a call when they pull in different directions. You work well with a wide range of stakeholders and build trust with people whose priorities differ from your own. You think strategically and can move between long-term direction and what we should ship next. You're comfortable with ambiguity and genuinely flexible (this industry is changing fast, AI most of all). You're curious about what AI actually changes for customers, and can tell real value from hype. More than 675,000 businesses, including McLaren Racing, Qantas, SHEIN, and TikTok, use us, directly or through our platform partners, to run their financial operations or build and monetize financial products of their own. We started in Melbourne in 2015 to build the infrastructure global commerce runs on. We're the regulated backbone behind global payments: not by accident, but by design. A decade plus, 85+ licenses, and a financial infrastructure spanning North America, Europe, the Middle East, and Asia-Pacific. We're co-headquartered in San Francisco and Singapore, with more than 2,700 people across 27 offices. We hire builders with founder-level energy, people who move fast with good judgment, dig in with real curiosity, and make calls from first principles rather than waiting to be told what to do. Read our operating principles to see it in full. How you'll make impact Airwallex is strengthening its global second-line Transaction Monitoring capability across products, payment rails and jurisdictions. You'll set the governance, challenge and modernisation agenda for a high-volume, global financial crime environment. Own Airwallex’s global second-line Transaction Monitoring strategy, governance framework and policy standards across products, payment rails, customer base and jurisdictions. Drive independent 2LOD challenge and oversight of 1LOD Transaction Monitoring teams, raising investigative rigour, alert disposition quality and consistency in suspicious activity detection. Oversee second line regional SAR/STR/SMR reporting teams in performance of L3 review and preparation of suspicious activity reports according to relevant requirements, in coordination with regional and local MLROs. Oversee the second line global Financial Intelligence Unit in performance of complex investigations, including cross-regional reviews, internal and external referrals, intelligence scanning and emerging risk typology development. Collaborate with the FCC Global Models lead on performance of appropriate governance of the global Transaction Monitoring rule lifecycle, covering typology identification, scenario logic, segmentation, threshold tuning, and above- and below-the-line testing across cross-border payments and multi-currency accounts. Lead the evolution from threshold-based monitoring towards AI-driven anomaly detection, machine-learning behavioural clustering and automated alert triage while maintaining explainability and regulatory defensibility. Partner with Product, Data Science and Engineering to embed Transaction Monitoring logic into core transaction-processing systems and real-time payment infrastructure. Resolve complex financial crime escalations, including novel laundering schemes, sanctions-evasion typologies and complex Suspicious Activity Report (SAR / STR) decisions. Improve model effectiveness by partnering with Model Risk Management, Quantitative teams and Audit to validate Transaction Monitoring models and maintain coverage mapping against global regulatory standards. Represent Airwallex’s Transaction Monitoring programme in regulatory examinations, including FCA, MAS, HKMA and AUSTRAC reviews, as well as partner-bank due diligence. What we're looking for Essentials 10+ years of dedicated AML and financial crime experience, with deep technical and operational expertise in Transaction Monitoring across global cross-border payments, corporate banking, FX or fintech platforms. 3+ years of experience leading, managing or mentoring compliance professionals in a global or multi-regional setting. Proven experience establishing 2LOD oversight frameworks, rule-governance processes and effective challenge mechanisms for high-volume, automated Transaction Monitoring platforms. Demonstrated ability to work with large datasets, SQL, data analytics and modern Transaction Monitoring models, translating business logic into technical parameters for Data Science and Engineering teams. Practical experience evaluating, testing or deploying AI/ML tools, graph analytics or automated dispositioning models in a regulatory compliance environment. Strong understanding of global AML rules, typology standards and reporting expectations across key regulators, including FCA, FinCEN, MAS, HKMA and AUSTRAC. A proven track record of managing regulatory examinations, internal or external audits and banking-partner inquiries relating to Transaction Monitoring systems and controls. Exceptional stakeholder-management and communication skills, with the ability to explain complex quantitative Transaction Monitoring models and risk decisions clearly to senior executives and external authorities. Based in the UK, ideally within reach of Birmingham, with the agility to collaborate across APAC, EMEA and Americas time zones. CAMS, CFCS, CFE or equivalent industry certification. A bachelor’s degree. Preferred A quantitative, technical, data or legal degree. Experience working across high-volume cross-border payments, corporate banking, FX or fintech platforms. Experience partnering with Model Risk Management, Quantitative teams, Product, Data Science, Engineering and Audit. You'll thrive here if You've operated in a compliance-heavy environment and know how to move fast without cutting the corners that matter. You're comfortable making decisions with incomplete information and moving quickly anyway. You’re comfortable operating across time zones with a globally distributed team, including colleagues based in APAC and EMEA. You simplify complexity rather than hiding behind it. You can advocate hard for a position, then fully support the team's direction once a call is made. Learn more about your team Regulatory & Compliance is where we build the trust, discipline, and operational resilience required to scale a generational financial platform. As Airwallex grows across 30+ markets, this team turns regulatory complexity into strategic control. You'll lead compliance, enterprise risk, and regulatory engagement in a way that protects the business while letting it move with conviction. Our ambition goes beyond meeting expectations: we're building a risk posture that acts as a competitive moat, grounded in ownership, proactive regulatory partnerships, and frameworks that scale globally while respecting local nuance. It's a team for strategic operators with sharp judgment, high standards, and the confidence to execute at pace in a high-stakes environment. You'll thrive here if you can balance rigor with progress and influence across functions. If you want to architect the benchmark for trust and resilience in global finance, your work here will have a massive impact. All official communication will come from an @ airwallex.com email address. Please apply only through careers.airwallex.com or our official LinkedIn page. A decade plus, 85+ licenses, and a financial infrastructure spanning North America, Europe, the Middle East, and Asia-Pacific. We're co-headquartered in San Francisco and Singapore, with more than 2,700 people across 27 offices. We hire builders with founder-level energy, people who move fast with good judgment, dig in with real curiosity, and make calls from first principles rather than waiting to be told what to do. Read our operating principles to see it in full. How you'll make impact As Sales Manager, SME & Growth, you’ll lead and coach a pod of Account Executives selling to SMB customers across the UK and selected EMEA territories. You’ll own a team quota, run a disciplined sales operating rhythm, and build the pipeline, forecasting and coaching practices needed to deliver in a high-velocity environment. You’ll embed MEDDPICC, SPICED or Challenger methodologies, strengthen outbound motions with SDRs and Marketing, and partner with Product, Revenue Strategy & Operations and other teams to shape go-to-market execution and support new market or business-line launches. Own team performance across SMB customers by setting clear expectations for activity, pipeline quality and sales results. Drive a disciplined operating rhythm through pipeline and forecast reviews, deal strategy sessions, call coaching and quarterly business reviews. Build consistent opportunity execution by embedding MEDDPICC, SPICED or Challenger methodologies, rigorous qualification, multi-threading and persona-based messaging. Expand outbound sales motions with SDRs and Marketing by shaping target segments, outreach cadences, content and reporting. Improve forecasting and decision-making through strong CRM hygiene, data quality and visibility into pipeline coverage, conversion, win rates and cycle times. Build team capability by hiring, onboarding, coaching and developing Account Executives, while partnering with Product, Marketing, Revenue Strategy & Operations and other stakeholders on market feedback, local go-to-market strategy and new market or business-line launches. You’ll work from our Manchester office three days a week. What we're looking for Essentials 5+ years of B2B sales experience, including at least 3 years as a closing Account Executive selling into SMB or mid-market segments. 2+ years in a frontline sales leadership or team-lead role, managing AEs, carrying a team quota and operating in a high-velocity sales environment. Proven success in an individual contributor AE role, with a strong track record of meeting or exceeding quota in B2B sales. Experience in high-growth tech or fintech, ideally with one or more of payments, FX, cards, accounts or spend management products. Experience launching or scaling a new market, region or business line, rather than only inheriting an established book of business. Hands-on experience building outbound sales motions with SDRs and Marketing, including designing cadences, qualification workflows and reporting. Strong, practical command of at least one modern B2B sales methodology such as MEDDPICC/MEDDIC, SPICED or Challenger, and the ability to coach others to use it effectively. Ability to establish and run strong cross-functional reporting cadences, using data and CRM insights to manage performance and communicate risk and opportunity. Proven ability to coach, develop and performance-manage Account Executives, including giving clear feedback and handling under-performance when needed. Preferred Experience selling multi-product fintech or payments platforms, for example combinations of accounts, payments, FX, cards and spend management, to CFO, finance and operations personas. Direct experience implementing or scaling MEDDPICC, SPICED or Challenger methodologies across a sales team or organisation, including building templates, training and inspection frameworks. Background in building or scaling sales teams in new or emerging EMEA markets. Familiarity with AI-powered sales tools and modern sales tech stacks, for example Salesforce, Outreach/Salesloft and Gong/Chorus, and using them to drive productivity and insight. Experience collaborating closely with Revenue Strategy & Operations and Enablement to design territories, KPIs and enablement programmes that support high-velocity sales growth. You'll thrive here if You have a track record of hitting your numbers, and you’re motivated by stretch goals. You’re comfortable making decisions with incomplete information and moving quickly anyway. You own the outcome and you don’t wait for permission to fix what’s broken. You enjoy working closely with people across multiple countries and time zones as part of one connected, global team, including flexing your hours occasionally to make that connection work. You know when to align and when to just decide. Collaboration isn't a way to avoid accountability. Learn more about your team SME & Growth at Airwallex is about more than closing deals. We help small and mid-market businesses solve real financial challenges across borders: getting paid globally, managing multi-currency accounts, paying suppliers, and running spend across markets from a single platform. You're not selling a feature. You're helping founders and finance leaders replace fragmented financial operations with one global system that actually scales. It's a function for sellers who like to build, not follow a script: curious, resourceful, and comfortable figuring things out in markets that are still wide open. You get real autonomy to create value, build relationships, and move opportunities forward. If you want to sell a serious product, solve real problems for ambitious businesses, and build your career fast, this is a place to do it. title: Software Engineer, Privacy Engineering (Lawful Access)
description: About the Team The Privacy Engineering team builds secure, reliable systems that help OpenAI meet its legal obligations while protecting user data. We partner closely with Legal and Engineering teams across OpenAI to support lawful data access requests and other critical legal workflows. Our work turns complex, high-stakes processes into auditable and dependable technical systems with clear human oversight and strong privacy and security controls. About the Role We’re looking for a full-stack Software Engineer to build the internal tools and data pipelines that power lawful data access request workflows and Legal Operations. You will work across product and data systems to make authorized retrieval and case handling accurate, efficient, and auditable. This role is well suited to someone who enjoys translating ambiguous operational requirements into durable systems, cares deeply about sensitive-data handling, and wants to improve both technical reliability and the day-to-day experience of the people operating these workflows. This role is based in San Francisco, CA, with two additional locations under consideration: London, UK, and Dublin, Ireland. We use a hybrid work model of 3 days in the office per week and offer relocation assistance to new employees. In this role, you will: Design, build, and operate backend systems and workflow tooling for the full lifecycle of lawful data access requests, from intake and scoping through authorized retrieval, review, preparation, and audit. Build reliable data pipelines and interfaces across products and data stores so authorized teams can locate and handle the right records accurately and reproducibly. Implement least-privilege access, approval gates, provenance, audit trails, data minimization, and safe failure modes for sensitive workflows. Partner with Legal and Legal Operations to translate legal and operational requirements into clear technical designs and intuitive operator experiences. Identify responsible automation opportunities that reduce repetitive work while preserving human review, judgment, and accountability. Own production systems through testing, observability, incident response, documentation, and continuous reliability improvements. Help define the architecture and roadmap for reusable privacy and legal-infrastructure foundations as OpenAI’s products and obligations evolve. You might thrive in this role if you: Have experience building or operating systems for lawful data access requests and understand the domain’s legal-process lifecycle, privacy and security constraints, auditability requirements, and operational sensitivities. Strong backend engineering fundamentals and experience building production services or data-intensive systems. Ability to reason carefully about correctness, authorization, security, and privacy when working with sensitive data. A track record of turning ambiguous requirements into pragmatic plans and communicating technical tradeoffs clearly. End-to-end ownership, including operating what you build, and comfort learning unfamiliar products and domains. Care for operator experience and a drive to make complex workflows safer, clearer, and more efficient. Experience collaborating across Engineering, Legal, operations, Privacy, and Security stakeholders. About OpenAI OpenAI is an AI research and deployment company dedicated to ensuring that general-purpose artificial intelligence benefits all of humanity. We push the boundaries of the capabilities of AI systems and seek to safely deploy them to the world through our products. AI is an extremely powerful tool that must be created with safety and human needs at its core, and to achieve our mission, we must encompass and value the many different perspectives, voices, and experiences that form the full spectrum of humanity. We are an equal opportunity employer, and we do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, sex, sexual orientation, age, veteran status, disability, genetic information, or other applicable legally protected characteristic. For additional information, please see OpenAI’s Affirmative Action and Equal Employment Opportunity Policy Statement . In addition, job duties require access to secure and protected information technology systems and related data security obligations. title: Marketing Operations Manager
description: About Pleo Messy spend management is tricky business. And tedious processes are a lose-lose situation for all involved, not just finance. At Pleo, we're changing that. We build spend solutions that make managing money seamless, empowering, and surprisingly effective for finance teams and employees alike - with a vision to help all businesses ‘go beyond’. The word ‘Pleo’ actually means ‘more than you’d expect’, and living by that mantra has been the secret to our success over the last 10 years. Now, we’re at a pivotal moment in our journey; every move we make has a direct impact on our 40,000+ customers, our business, and our collective success. We need people who take pride in uncovering customer needs, who turn complex problems into simple solutions, challenge the way things are done (respectfully), and always aim high. With great ambitions driving us forward, we can’t say we’ve got this whole thing figured out. And frankly, that’s half the fun! What we can say is that we’re a driven, progressive, and, importantly, a kind bunch of 850+ people from over 100 nationalities, all committed to delivering the future of business spending, together. About the role We're looking for a Marketing Operations Manager to join our Marketing Operations, RevOps team at Pleo. In this role, you'll help build the operational infrastructure needed to support our upmarket expansion into Mid-Market and Enterprise segments and be part of our Marketing Ops team as we scale our spend management platform across growth companies in Europe. If you're excited about designing account-based go-to-market systems, establishing AI enablement across operational workflows, and solving complex cross-functional challenges, and are passionate about marketing operations, RevOps, and systems architecture, then this is the opportunity for you! Who you’ll be working with and reporting to You’ll report to our Associate Director, Marketing Operations and work closely with teams in Marketing Operations, RevOps, and Sales Ops. Our team is highly collaborative and dedicated to powering how the marketing team runs—from campaign operations and reporting cadence through to AI adoption and process improvement. You’ll also have the chance to partner with teams across Data, BAT (Business Automation & Tools), CX Ops, and Engineering to ensure success and maintain a single account truth across systems. What you’ll be doing As a Marketing Operations Manager, you will: Build and refine marketing operational frameworks – Lead initiatives to continuously improve campaign workflows, request intake, approval processes, team governance, MQL→MQA routing logic, and SDR/BDR handoff processes. Own account intelligence and reporting cadence – Design account scoring models for Mid-Market and Enterprise, maintain executive dashboards, integrate intent/firmographic/behavioral signals into segmentation, and manage account assignment logic. Drive AI adoption across Marketing Ops – Translate AI capabilities into operational reality by building processes, governance, and enablement that accelerate execution and scale output within the team. Ensure tooling health and systems ownership – Manage HubSpot workflows, automations, and integrations while coordinating with BAT and Engineering on tech stack builds, QA standards, and enterprise tooling requirements. Enable team capabilities and documentation habits – Upskill Marketing and Marketing Ops teammates through shared standards, QA checklists, repeatable guides, templates, and onboarding resources to raise the operational floor. What you bring You’ll thrive in this role if you have: HubSpot Fluency – A solid understanding of designing workflows, routing logic, and automation in HubSpot, including its limitations and when to extend outside the platform. Account Operations Mindset – Track record of building ABM operational processes, MQL-to-MQA scoring rules, multi-stakeholder buying committee motions, and AI/automation adoption that sticks. Sales Ops Partnership – Ability to collaborate seamlessly with Sales Ops on account strategy, territory strategy, handoff logic, and rep productivity without jargon. Data & Documentation Habits – Excellent habits in building auditable specs, validating data quality, and diagnosing root causes in data flows alongside Data and BAT teams. Experience with multi-touch attribution modeling, lifecycle marketing operations (nurture flows, recycling, engagement scoring), and ABM platforms / account intelligence tools. A background in seeing a company move upmarket to Mid-Market/Enterprise and building scalable, long-term GTM operations. Why is this role a good fit for you This role is a good fit for you if: You are an operational thinker who naturally designs sustainable systems, governance, and frameworks rather than executing quick-fix tasks. You love working cross-functionally across Marketing, Sales Ops, and Data teams to streamline GTM processes and remove friction. You are energized by driving practical AI adoption and upskilling team members through documentation, templates, and shared standards. This role is not a good fit for you if: You prefer operating in established, rigid systems rather than designing new account-based infrastructure in ambiguous environments. You look at marketing operations as purely executing inbound lead lists without considering account context or buying committees. You rely on tribal knowledge rather than maintaining clear, auditable documentation and QA standards for your builds. How you’ll develop in this role In your first 6 months at Pleo, you’ll: Lead the launch of our account segmentation model to directly power SDR assignments and Mid-Market/Enterprise routing. Collaborate with Data and Marketing Ops teams to clean up attribution, reporting, and lifecycle data so performance metrics are fully trusted. Grow your skills in AI enablement, enterprise GTM systems, and cross-functional RevOps alignment, taking on new challenges as the company continues to scale. We’re committed to helping you develop your career, whether that means taking on bigger projects, stepping into leadership, or acquiring new skills in advanced RevOps and enterprise go-to-market strategies. The location Please note: We can hire on a hybrid or in-person set-up in any of the locations listed on the advert but you will need to be physically based in the country of your choice with a valid right to work . We are unable to offer visa sponsorship for this role in any of the listed locations. Show me the benefits! Your own Pleo card (no more out-of-pocket spending!) Lunch is on us for your work days - enjoy catered meals or receive a lunch allowance based on your local office Comprehensive private healthcare - depending on your location, coverage options include Vitality, Alan or Médis 25 days of annual leave + public holidays (additional days may apply in select countries based on local standards). For our Team, we offer both hybrid and fully remote working options We use MyndUp to give our employees access to free mental health and well-being support with great success so far Paid parental leave - we want to make sure that we're supportive of families and help you feel that you don't have to compromise your family due to work The interview process We want to ensure you are set-up for success and understand what will be expected of you. If your application is successful, our interview process is as follows: Intro call: A 30-minute chat with our Talent Partner to discuss the role and your background. Hiring Manager Interview: A 45 mins chat with the hiring manager, to deep dive in your experience and role Pleo Challenge and Team Interview: We will send you a take home test and invite you to present during a 60 minute team interview. This is an opportunity to show us how you would handle the day to day of the role Final Interview: A final interview with a senior leader Transparency is important to us so we also wanted to share some insights about what we’re looking for in applications to ensure you can set yourself up for success! Last time we hired for this role, we received a vast number of applications but only a few were selected for an intro call. Some of the key reasons why previous candidates didn’t make it past the application screening stage include: CV writing and content: we receive a lot of CVs, and many of them are AI-generated. title: Manager, AI Engineering
description: About SandboxAQ SandboxAQ is a high-growth company delivering AI solutions that address some of the world's greatest challenges. The company’s Large Quantitative Models (LQMs) power advances in life sciences, financial services, navigation, cybersecurity, and other sectors. We are a global team that is tech-focused and includes experts in AI, chemistry, cybersecurity, physics, mathematics, medicine, engineering, and other specialties. The company emerged from Alphabet Inc. as an independent, growth capital-backed company in 2022, funded by leading investors and supported by a braintrust of industry leaders. At SandboxAQ, we’ve cultivated an environment that encourages creativity, collaboration, and impact. By investing deeply in our people, we’re building a thriving, global workforce poised to tackle the world's epic challenges. Join us to advance your career in pursuit of an inspiring mission, in a community of like-minded people who value entrepreneurialism, ownership, and transformative impact. The Opportunity The SandboxAQ AI team is looking for a hands-on Manager, AI Engineering to help us build the future of agentic collaboration, trust and ROI. Our goal is to make agents work well on their own, in teams, and with humans. This includes the following aspects: Security : Discovery of agents, evaluation, red teaming, monitoring, guardrails, etc. Quality : Measuring ROI of agents and suggesting improvements Collaboration : Bringing humans and agents together into one place with shared context A successful candidate thrives at the intersection of AI and software engineering. You deeply understand how models and agents work, how they can fail, how they can be protected and improved. You have hands-on experience with agents in production, know what works and what doesn’t, know the latest trends and you’re opinionated about the future. You know what you don’t know and enjoy learning to close those gaps. You’ll turn your insights and innovation into real world features baked into our platform - shipping code to production. This is a hands-on leadership role where you’ll break things, fix them and then harden them for good while also leading a small team of engineers. At the same time, you’ll have freedom to explore, collaborate, publish, and deploy, shaping the field of agentic collaboration and trust from all angles. You will help set technical direction, raise the quality bar, mentor team members, and ensure that the team moves quickly from research insight to real-world product impact. We’re looking for somebody with the curiosity of a researcher, the rigor of an engineer, and the creativity of a hacker. You will be part of a diverse team consisting of ML experts, security experts, mathematicians, and software engineers, each playing a key role in efficient and effective enablement of the cutting-edge technologies being developed at SandboxAQ. Key Responsibilities Lead and grow a small, highly technical team while remaining deeply involved in hands-on engineering and research. Set technical direction, break down ambiguous problems, establish practical plans for fast, high-quality execution, and build a culture of ownership, low-ego collaboration, thoughtful experimentation, and high standards. Create new agentic capabilities, including frameworks for monitoring, guardrailing, and evaluating agents, while staying current on the latest agentic developments and identifying new opportunities. Perform classical ML tasks, including exploratory data analysis, feature engineering, and model fine-tuning, and rapidly iterate on prototypes and features based on feedback and evolving product needs. Work closely with Product and Research to translate AI research into applicable features and software engineering projects. Contribute production-ready code and technical designs, working across engineering to deliver scalable, reliable software. Essential Skills & Experience BSc in Computer Science or related field with exposure to AI/ML. Deep expertise in AI/ML, software engineering, or AI security. Strong programming skills in Python, and relevant ML and/or agentic frameworks. Demonstrated ability to work cross-functionally and collaboratively with a high degree of end-to-end ownership, delivering real world outcomes. Ability to pick up other programming languages and technologies as required to ship scalable and reliable software. Highly Desired Skills & Experience PhD in Computer Science or related field with focus on AI/ML or similar. Hands-on experience with at least one of the following: agent orchestration, agent harnesses, agent teams, jailbreaking / prompt injection, red teaming, data poisoning or evasion attacks, secure model deployment or sandboxing, detection and monitoring for AI misuse. Experience contributing to open source projects. Experience in a fast-paced startup environment. Experience in cybersecurity is a plus, but not essential. Why Join Us? We offer a comprehensive and competitive benefits package designed to support your health, financial well-being, and life outside of work. Career Defining Work : Your work will directly accelerate the discovery of better drugs and better materials, advance human health, and enable safer and more sustainable technologies by helping customers put AI Simulation capabilities into real world use. Compensation: Competitive base salary, performance-based incentives or bonuses (where applicable), and equity participation. Benefits: Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision coverage for employees and dependents with generous employer premium contributions, retirement savings with company matching, paid parental leave, and inclusive family-building benefits. Work-Life Balance: Fully remote, Flexible paid time off, company-wide seasonal breaks, and support for flexible work arrangements that enable sustainable performance. Learning and Growth: Opportunities for continuous learning and growth through on-the-job development, cross-functional collaboration, and access to internal learning and development programs. SandboxAQ Welcomes All We are committed to fostering a culture of belonging and respect, where diverse perspectives are actively sought and valued. Our multidisciplinary environment provides ample opportunity for continuous growth - working alongside humble, empowered, and ambitious colleagues ready to tackle epic challenges. Equal Employment Opportunity : All qualified applicants will receive consideration regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity, or Veteran status. Accommodations : We provide reasonable accommodations for individuals with disabilities in job application procedures for open roles. If you need such an accommodation, please let a member of our Recruiting team know. Strong knowledge of financial statements, accounting principles, and investment analysis. Capability to comprehend and collaborate with various lines of business. Willingness to stretch beyond your comfort zone and embrace new challenges. Openness to feedback, with a commitment to continuous improvement, development, and innovation. Bachelor's degree in finance, economics, or a quantitative field. title: Account Executive
description: We're looking for an Account Executive to close new-logo business for Cytix in a market where most of the people you're calling haven't heard of us yet. You'll be selling a product, not a service, into CISOs, security engineers and AppSec leads, which means the pitch has to work on its own merits rather than on brand recognition. This is a full-cycle closing role: you'll run discovery, demo and negotiation yourself, with support from the CRO on the harder deals while you build that muscle. You'll carry mid-market opportunities to start, working alongside SDR-sourced pipeline as well as your own prospecting, with a clear path to Senior Account Executive as your quota, deal complexity and independence grow. What you'll do Run full-cycle new-logo opportunities from qualified meeting through discovery, demo and close, sourced by SDR, Marketing and your own prospecting. Generate some of your own pipeline alongside SDR support, prospecting into a clearly defined ideal customer profile. Run structured discovery calls solo, identifying pain and priorities for your primary buyer. Close mid-market deals with negotiation support from the CRO as you build experience with more complex procurement. Maintain your own weekly pipeline and forecast, developing commit accuracy over time. Work SDR and Customer Success handoffs as directed, keeping CRM records clean and up to date. What you'll bring 3–5 years' full-cycle closing experience in B2B SaaS, or a strong track record in an adjacent commercial role (for example SDR) ready to step up. A track record at or near 100% of quota (around £500k–£750k) in at least one of the last two years. Real consultative selling instinct: you'd rather understand a prospect's problem than run a script at them. Comfortable prospecting and selling into accounts with little existing awareness of Cytix, energised by the challenge of a cold or lightly-worked start. Visible drive and competitiveness, and a willingness to take on unfamiliar deal types or buyer personas when asked. Genuinely bright and inquisitive : good follow-up questions come naturally to you, and you're genuinely curious about the product and the security market, including how software gets built and secured. Drawn to a business where new challenges show up daily; you want to take ownership of them and lean in, rather than needing everything mapped out in advance. Comfortable taking yourself out of your comfort zone when a deal or a buyer is unfamiliar territory. What you'll get Time off that works for you: Unlimited holiday policy, including a guaranteed 33 days plus your birthday off Flexible hybrid working: Work in a way that helps you do your best work, while staying connected with the team. A stake in what we’re building: Eligible employees can participate in our EMI share option scheme. Healthcare that goes further: After one year’s service, access private healthcare through Vitality, including dental, optical, hearing and therapy cover. More ways to get around: Access our company car salary-sacrifice scheme. Support for growing families: Enhanced maternity and paternity leave. About Cytix Software never stops changing. Teams ship new code every day, through tickets, pull requests, releases, and increasingly with AI in the mix, but the way security keeps up with all that change hasn't really moved on. That's the problem we're solving. Cytix helps organisations understand which software changes actually matter, what should happen next, and how to prove the right call was made. Security understood, in other words. We're a small team with big plans, so every person we hire genuinely shapes what Cytix becomes. That's why we're upfront about our five values: we interview for all of them, and they matter to us more than a perfect CV. They're things you do, not things you are, so have a read and see if they sound like you. Make the first move . When the goal is clear but the path isn't, you get moving rather than waiting for perfect instructions. If you're blocked, you make a sensible call, say what you're assuming, and explain how you'd course-correct. We'd rather you act and be slightly wrong than sit still. Find the smarter path. You ask why before how. You dig into what the real problem is instead of just building what the spec says, and you're happy to question 'that's how it's always been done' when the reason behind it has gone stale. See it through. When something's yours, it lands. No loose ends, no surprises for whoever picks it up next. You keep people posted when things change, and if something falls between roles, you catch it. Raise the bar. You do the best job possible in the time you've got, whether that's a day or a month. Sometimes that means deep craft; sometimes the smartest move is quick and scrappy. It's about good judgement, and we hold each other to it without blame or politics. Play to win. You care about the mission but don't take yourself too seriously. You say 'I' when things go wrong and 'we' when they go right, trust teammates to do things their own way, and bring a bit of humour when the pressure's on.
